entry.name: jit.openexr
entry.digest: Read or write an OpenEXR image.
entry.description: Converts an OpenEXR image to and from a jit.matrix object for an arbitrary number of planes or color components.

attributes.name: adjust
attributes.digest: HDR image adjustment flag
attributes.description: Flag to enable or disable adjusting the HDR image data through ILM's proposed display mapping pipeline (default = 0). When enabled, the exposure, defog, kneehigh, kneelow, and normalize attributes can be used to control the following display mapping process:1. Compensate for fogging by subtracting defog from the raw pixel values.2. Multiply the defogged pixel values by 2(exposure + 2.47393).3. Values, which are now 1.0, are called "middle gray." If defog and exposure are both set to 0.0, then middle gray corresponds to a raw pixel value of 0.18. In step 6, middle gray values will be mapped to an intensity 3.5 f-stops below the display's maximum intensity.4. Apply a knee function. The knee function has two parameters, kneeLow and kneeHigh. Pixel values below 2kneeLow are not changed by the knee function. Pixel values above kneeLow are lowered according to a logarithmic curve, such that the value 2kneeHigh is mapped to 23.5 (in step 6, this value will be mapped to the display's maximum intensity).5. Gamma-correct the pixel values.6. Scale the values such that middle gray pixels are mapped to 84.66 (or 3.5 f-stops below the display's maximum intensity).7. If converting to 8 bit unsigned integer values (char), clamp the values to [0, 255].

attributes.name: channels
attributes.digest: List of channel names to use
attributes.description: The list of channel names to use. When reading an OpenEXR file into aobject, these channels will be mapped to sequential planes. If a channel does not exist it will be filled with zeros. When writing aobject, the names listed in this list will be used to name each plane as they are stored in the OpenEXR file. (default = null)

attributes.name: defog
attributes.digest: Defog offset
attributes.description: Value subtracted from pixel values to compensate for fogging due to stray light in the recording device (default = 0.0).

attributes.name: exposure
attributes.digest: Apparent image exposure on the display
attributes.description: Sets the apparent exposure of the image on the display. It lightens or darkens the displayed image, allowing you to reveal detail in the high or low end. (default = 0.0)

attributes.name: normalize
attributes.digest: Floating point normalization flag
attributes.description: Flag to enable or disable normalization for rempping the floating point data into a uniform range of 0-1. This operation will be performed before the display mapping process. (default = 0)

attributes.description: In order to output the contents of an openexr file from JS users must either provide an input matrix or enable outputfile.

messages.description: Reads the given file into ausing the indicated channels listed in the channel attribute. File read notifications are sent out of the dump outlet as a list composed of the message read, the path to the file, and a 0 or 1, where 0 = failure, 1 = success.
